title: GTA 6 Age Rating Reveals Lucia and Jason Can Use Drugs Directly From Inventory
description: A new age rating for GTA 6 reveals that protagonists Lucia and Jason can partake in frequent drug use directly from their inventory at any time.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Age Rating Reveals New Details on Drug Use Mechanisms

As anticipation continues to build for the release of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, new information has emerged from a recent age rating report. According to a report by Eurogamer, *GTA 6* is seemingly adding another activity to the franchise's extensive list of mature pastimes, pointing towards a new level of interactive freedom for its protagonists.

Joining the traditional strip clubs, violent car-jackings, and carefree murder depicted throughout the series, the new age rating highlights "frequent and prominent" drug use. What makes this particular detail stand out is the mechanic itself: players will reportedly be able to partake in these substances "directly from their inventory" and "at any time," according to the age rating findings.

## Deepening the Mature Open-World Experience

Rockstar Games has always pushed the boundaries of open-world simulation, portraying the gritty and unfiltered realities of modern criminal subcultures. The ability for characters like Lucia and Jason to access and consume drugs dynamically from their personal inventory suggests a granular approach to character management and world immersion. While the franchise has never shied away from mature themes, integrating such elements directly into the player's everyday inventory management system emphasizes the raw, unpolished lifestyle of its lead characters.

## Editor's Take

The revelation from the age rating details highlights Rockstar's commitment to delivering an uncompromised, mature open-world experience in *GTA 6*. Allowing players to trigger drug use directly from their inventory at any moment adds a layer of gritty realism to Lucia and Jason's day-to-day survival and criminal escapades. It remains to be seen how this mechanic will physically affect gameplay and character stats when the game finally launches.
